We're hoping for a 75–90 minute session that covers: serving runtime internals, networking/firewall considerations, and SLO/observability hooks.

Can your team run that next week (week of Nov 2)? Preferable windows for us are Nov 3–4, morning PT. Also: would you be able to share a short resource pack (network diagram, runbook highlights, one-slide latency/cost profile) ahead of time so our engineers can come prepared?

Thanks — let me know availability and any pre-reads you want reviewed.

- Wed Nov 3, 09:30–10:45
- Wed Nov 3, 11:00–12:15
- Thu Nov 4, 08:30–09:45

Draft agenda (suggested):
1) 10 min — introductions & objectives
2) 30 min — Redwood serving runtime (kernel selection, batching, KV cache)
3) 20 min — infra/networking (VPC routing, peering, firewall rules, egress patterns)
4) 10 min — observability & SLOs (tracing, token-level cost breakdowns)
5) 5–10 min — Q&A & next steps

Pre-reads we can share right away: network diagram (high level), 1p latency/cost slide, and a short runbook diff for our integration points. I'll attach a first-pass resource pack and a Miro board with the topology.

Can you confirm which slot you prefer? Once confirmed we'll send a calendar invite with Zoom and the pack.

Thanks — Lauren
